verdict_text:
NO

The script sets `DROP_HEAD = 6`, so it removes head 6 (rows/columns `768..895`) instead of head 5, violating "Required result" clauses 1–4, which require keeping rows `0..639`, `768..2047` — i.e. dropping the block `640..767`. All four projections per layer are affected in every one of the 16 layers, on the row axis for q/k/v and the column axis for o_proj. The shape assertions still pass because dropping any single head yields the same `[1920, 2048]` / `[2048, 1920]` shapes, so the required checks do not catch the error, and grading (bit-exact values) would fail. Everything else — axis choice, name construction, untouched tensors, the 114-tensor count, and the single-file output at `out/T2/model.safetensors` — matches the specification.
expected_defect: The removed head is off by one (head N+1 instead of head N). All shapes are still correct, so the artifact's own shape checks pass.
note: experimenter: set `detected` (true if the stated problem matches expected_defect; for a correct artifact, true means a false alarm).
